# Feature 3: soft delete for comments

## Rules
1. Delete behavior and list visibility: policy-soft-delete.md, bytes 0-194 (Neuron, team vault).
2. Who may delete: policy-soft-delete.md, bytes 0-194.
3. Error body shape: policy-error-response.md, bytes 23-202. Followed over ops-runbook.md (bytes 0-235), which gives an older shape.
4. Error status codes: code-error-shape.md, bytes 0-504 (Neuron). Policy says codes are unchanged.
5. Comment fields: code-comment-model.md, bytes 0-245, and app/src/prisma/schema.prisma. Neuron omitted an edit timestamp that the schema has; followed the schema.

## Conflicts and gaps
- Delete: policy says soft delete. code-comment-model.md and deleteComment in app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts hard-delete. Target follows the policy; the current code is what changes.
- Non-author delete: deleteComment filters by author, so non-authors get 404 and the 403 branch is unreachable. No rule I found sets the code. Open for the team.

## Builder notes
- Read rule values from the sources at build time, not from this file.
- The deletion timestamp needs a migration in app/src/prisma/migrations/.
